title: An Illusion of Progress? Assessing the Current State of Web Agents
authors_zh: Tianci Xue, Weijian Qi, Tianneng Shi, Chan Hee Song, Boyu Gou, Dawn Song, Huan Sun, Yu Su
paper_type_zh: 在线网页智能体基准、轨迹评测与奖励验证器
best_for_zh: 研究在线网页智能体、视觉轨迹评测、LLM judge、奖励模型、任务漂移与可回放性的读者
one_line: Online-Mind2Web releases 300 mutable live-site tasks, evaluation code and task-level labels plus WebJudge-7B, but not a complete immutable corpus of all paper trajectories or the external website states needed for exact replay.
Online-Mind2Web 发布 300 个会随真实网站变化的任务、评测代码、任务级标签与 WebJudge-7B，但未形成包含六类论文智能体全部截图/动作及网站快照的不可变轨迹语料。
why: It couples realistic browser episodes with human and judge feedback while exposing how screenshot selection, task replacement, web drift, execution failures, judge choice, and incomplete trajectory retention affect evaluation and reward-model reuse.
inclusion_reason: Online-Mind2Web makes the gap between cached/offline web traces and mutable real-site episodes auditable: tasks, screenshots, factual actions, human labels, WebJudge selection/judgment, task updates, and replay failures jointly determine whether a web-agent trajectory is credible evaluation or reward data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Online-Mind2Web asks whether apparent web-agent progress survives a move from cached pages or stale demonstrations to the live web. The authors first sampled 650 original Mind2Web tasks and found that 47% were invalid or paired with outdated reference trajectories. They therefore built a 300-task suite spanning 136 websites and 12 domains: 167 selected Mind2Web tasks, 24 rewritten tasks, 34 Mind2Web-Live tasks, and 75 newly authored tasks. Difficulty is defined by reference length: 83 easy tasks require at most 5 steps, 143 medium tasks require 6–10, and 74 hard tasks require at least 11.

The released task object is intentionally small: task ID, starting website, natural-language task, and reference length. The evaluated data object is larger and time-dependent: a browser episode contains screenshots, URLs when available, actions, optional thoughts, a final answer, and post-hoc feedback. Because execution occurs on public websites, the task and observation distribution can change after publication. The benchmark is therefore both an evaluation set and a maintenance process, not an immutable trajectory dataset.

For an atlas of reasoning data, the central question is provenance and feedback: which prompt version produced which live episode, what the agent observed and did, whether each action visibly took effect, and why humans or WebJudge judged the terminal outcome successful. Official artifacts expose the current tasks, evaluator, labels, example trajectories, submission schema, and WebJudge-7B. They do not establish a complete public corpus of every paper trajectory or a frozen website state sufficient for exact replay.

Online-Mind2Web 追问：当网页智能体从缓存页面或过时演示转向实时网页时，表面上的能力进步是否仍然成立。作者先随机抽取 650 个原始 Mind2Web 任务，发现其中 47% 已失效或对应的参考轨迹已经过时。由此构建的最终套件含 300 个任务、覆盖 136 个网站和 12 个领域：167 个筛选保留的 Mind2Web 任务、24 个改写任务、34 个 Mind2Web-Live 任务和 75 个新编任务。难度由参考长度定义：83 个简单任务至多 5 步，143 个中等任务为 6–10 步，74 个困难任务至少 11 步。

公开任务对象刻意保持精简：任务 ID、起始网站、自然语言任务与参考长度。真正参与评测的数据对象更大且依赖时间：浏览器 episode 包含截图、可获得时的 URL、动作、可选思维、最终回答与事后反馈。由于执行发生在公开网站上，任务与观察分布会在论文发布后继续变化。因此，这既是一套评测集，也是一套持续维护流程，而不是不可变的轨迹数据集。

对推理数据图谱而言，核心问题是来源与反馈：哪个任务版本产生了哪条在线 episode，智能体看到什么、执行什么，每个动作是否在界面上产生可见效果，以及人类或 WebJudge 为何判定终局成功。官方工件公开了当前任务、评测器、标签、示例轨迹、提交 schema 与 WebJudge-7B；但尚不能证明六类论文智能体的全部轨迹已作为完整语料公开，也没有冻结到足以精确回放的网站状态。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution couples a maintained live-web task suite with a trajectory-aware evaluator. An agent starts from the designated site and emits browser actions against changing pages. The current v2 submission schema stores task metadata and an ordered action history; each step can bind an index, screenshot, URL, normalized action, nullable thought, and optional action status. Its SUCCESS or FAILED status only says whether the action had a visible effect. It is not the episode reward.

Episode feedback comes from two contracts. Human annotators assign failure, success, or not executable, with at least two annotators per trajectory and a third adjudicator for conflict. WebJudge produces a binary outcome through a staged procedure: extract task key points, summarize and score screenshot relevance, retain frames at threshold 3, then judge the outcome from the task, key points, selected screenshots, and factual action history. It excludes the agent's final answer and thoughts because those fields can hallucinate completion and differ across agent implementations.

WebJudge-7B is a released Qwen2.5-VL-7B derivative trained for the screenshot-summary and relevance stage. It is not a fully self-contained replacement for the entire evaluator: reported inference still uses an LLM for key-point extraction and final outcome judgment. This boundary makes the reward-modeling claim specific and auditable rather than treating all released tasks or agent trajectories as preference data.

该工作的核心是把持续维护的实时网页任务集与轨迹感知评测器结合起来。智能体从指定网站出发，在持续变化的页面上执行浏览器动作。当前 v2 提交 schema 把任务元数据与有序动作历史绑定；每一步可包含序号、截图、URL、标准化动作、可为空的思维，以及可选的动作状态。其中 SUCCESS 或 FAILED 只表示该动作是否产生可见效果，并不等同于 episode 奖励。

Episode 反馈有两套契约。人类标注者给出失败、成功或不可执行；每条轨迹至少由两人标注，冲突时由第三人裁决。WebJudge 通过分阶段流程输出二元结果：提取任务关键点，概括并评分截图相关性，以阈值 3 保留画面，再依据任务、关键点、筛选后的截图与事实动作历史判断终局。它排除智能体最终回答和思维，因为这些字段可能虚构完成状态，而且不同智能体实现并不一致。

WebJudge-7B 是公开的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 衍生模型，仅针对截图概括与相关性阶段训练。它不是整个评测器的完全独立替代品：论文报告的推理仍由 LLM 完成关键点提取和最终结果判断。这个边界使“奖励建模”的说法保持具体且可审计，而不会把所有公开任务或智能体轨迹笼统视为偏好数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The construction pipeline begins with task viability. From 650 sampled Mind2Web tasks, the curators remove ambiguous, outdated, invalid, or strong-CAPTCHA cases, rewrite solvable tasks where needed, and add tasks from Mind2Web-Live and new sites. The 300-task release contains 167 selected, 24 rewritten, 34 Mind2Web-Live, and 75 new tasks over 136 websites and 12 domains, including 14 niche-site tasks. Later task replacements preserve website and approximate reference-length difficulty where possible, so a task revision must be part of any run manifest.

Six agents generate live episodes: SeeAct, Agent-E, Browser Use, Claude Computer Use 3.5, Claude Computer Use 3.7, and Operator. Open agents use Playwright, Claude Computer Use uses local Chrome, and Operator uses a remote browser. SeeAct, Agent-E, and Browser Use receive at most 25 steps; Claude Computer Use 3.7 receives at most 50 with thinking disabled; Operator's budget is undisclosed. The main comparison starts at the designated website and prohibits Google Search. Viewports and screenshot capture differ by agent.

Humans label every evaluated trajectory with at least 2 annotators and a third adjudicator on disagreement. WebJudge extracts key points, scores screenshot relevance, keeps frames scoring at least 3, and predicts success from visible evidence plus factual actions. WebJudge-7B fine-tunes Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic relevance targets from GPT-4o, GPT-4.1-mini, Claude 3.7, and Qwen2.5-VL-72B. Its training trajectories come from SeeAct, Browser Use, and Claude Computer Use 3.5; Agent-E, Claude Computer Use 3.7, and Operator are held out. Training uses 4 H100 80GB GPUs, bfloat16, batch 256, sequence length 4096, 5 epochs, learning rate 5e-6, cosine decay, and 10% warmup.

The repository's v2 schema serializes each step as one object, avoiding the silent action/thought/screenshot desynchronization possible in v1 parallel arrays. Even so, reproducibility requires more than schema conformance: the task revision, page state, browser and viewport, account/cookie/locale state, agent/model settings, retries, full screenshot/action package, label provenance, and evaluator revision must all be retained.

构建流程首先检查任务可执行性。对抽取的 650 个 Mind2Web 任务，策展者移除歧义、过时、失效或被强 CAPTCHA 阻断的案例，在必要时改写仍可求解的任务，并从 Mind2Web-Live 与新网站补充任务。最终 300 个任务由 167 个筛选任务、24 个改写任务、34 个 Mind2Web-Live 任务和 75 个新任务组成，覆盖 136 个网站和 12 个领域，其中含 14 个小众网站任务。后续替换任务时尽量保持网站与大致参考长度难度，因此任何运行清单都必须记录任务修订版本。

六类智能体生成实时 episode：SeeAct、Agent-E、Browser Use、Claude Computer Use 3.5、Claude Computer Use 3.7 与 Operator。开源智能体使用 Playwright，Claude Computer Use 使用本地 Chrome，Operator 使用远程浏览器。SeeAct、Agent-E 与 Browser Use 最多 25 步；Claude Computer Use 3.7 最多 50 步且关闭 thinking；Operator 的预算未披露。主比较从指定网站开始，并禁止 Google Search。不同智能体的视口与截图方式并不一致。

每条评测轨迹至少由 2 名人类标注者判断，分歧时由第三人裁决。WebJudge 提取关键点、评分截图相关性、保留得分至少为 3 的画面，再依据可见证据和事实动作预测成功。WebJudge-7B 在由 GPT-4o、GPT-4.1-mini、Claude 3.7 与 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 合成的相关性目标上微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B。训练轨迹来自 SeeAct、Browser Use 与 Claude Computer Use 3.5；Agent-E、Claude Computer Use 3.7 与 Operator 留出。训练使用 4 张 H100 80GB、bfloat16、批量 256、序列长度 4096、5 个 epoch、学习率 5e-6、余弦衰减与 10% warmup。

仓库的 v2 schema 把每一步序列化为单一对象，避免 v1 平行动作、思维与截图数组可能发生的静默错位。不过，符合 schema 仍不足以保证复现：还必须保留任务修订、网页状态、浏览器与视口、账户/cookie/locale 状态、智能体和模型设置、重试、完整截图/动作包、标签来源及评测器修订。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Human evaluation reports Operator at 61% success and Claude Computer Use 3.7 at 56.3%, while the other evaluated systems cluster around 30%. These numbers support the paper's main diagnosis: strong systems remain far from reliable on broad live-site tasks, and offline or narrow benchmarks can overstate progress.

Against Online-Mind2Web human labels, the GPT-4o WebJudge variant averages 83.6% agreement. WebJudge with o4-mini reaches 85.7% agreement and a 3.8-point absolute success-rate gap; WebJudge-7B reaches 87.0% agreement and a 3.9-point gap while using 2 model calls per trajectory. Screenshot thresholds 2, 3, and 4 yield 79.3%, 81.8%, and 77.0% agreement in the reported ablation. GPT-4o at temperature 0 is still stochastic: across 3 runs, average success-rate standard deviation is 1.1% and the maximum is 1.8%.

On the 1,302-trajectory AgentRewardBench transfer test, reported precision is 73.7% for GPT-4o, 75.7% for WebJudge-7B, and 82.0% for o4-mini. The paper also warns that o4-mini can obtain high precision with low recall. Agreement and aggregate success-rate gaps therefore do not prove calibrated rewards, exact replay, or complete data retention. They measure evaluator alignment on the released evaluation setting, subject to frame selection, judge bias, site executability, and human-label uncertainty.

人类评测中，Operator 成功率为 61%，Claude Computer Use 3.7 为 56.3%，其余被测系统集中在约 30%。这些数字支持论文的核心诊断：即使是强系统，在覆盖广泛真实网站的任务上仍远未可靠，而离线或窄域基准可能高估进展。

相对 Online-Mind2Web 人类标签，GPT-4o 版 WebJudge 的平均一致率为 83.6%。采用 o4-mini 的 WebJudge 达到 85.7% 一致率，绝对成功率差为 3.8 个百分点；WebJudge-7B 达到 87.0% 一致率与 3.9 个百分点差，并且每条轨迹使用 2 次模型调用。截图阈值 2、3、4 在消融中分别得到 79.3%、81.8%、77.0% 一致率。即使温度为 0，GPT-4o 仍有随机性：3 次运行的平均成功率标准差为 1.1%，最大为 1.8%。

在含 1,302 条轨迹的 AgentRewardBench 迁移测试上，GPT-4o、WebJudge-7B 与 o4-mini 的报告精确率分别为 73.7%、75.7% 与 82.0%。论文还指出，o4-mini 可能以低召回换取高精确率。因此，一致率与汇总成功率差并不能证明奖励已校准、轨迹可精确回放或数据保留完整；它们只衡量发布评测设置中的 evaluator 对齐，并受截图筛选、judge 偏差、网站可执行性及人类标签不确定性影响。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The strongest novelty is the combination of broad, maintained live-site tasks with a visual, trajectory-aware outcome judge. Earlier web benchmarks already supplied web tasks, demonstrations, live interaction, or model-based scoring separately. Online-Mind2Web makes task decay and website drift first-class evaluation concerns, and WebJudge separates key-point extraction, evidence-frame selection, and terminal judgment.

For data curation, the useful conceptual advance is the explicit distinction among an action trace, action-effect status, and episode success. A click can execute successfully while the task fails; an episode can be not executable because the site changed; and a judge can fail because the decisive screenshot was filtered out. This decomposition is reusable for reward and verifier datasets beyond web browsing.

The later v2 submission schema is valuable release engineering, but it should not be retroactively read as proof that all paper runs were captured under that schema. Likewise, WebJudge-7B is evidence of reusable reward-model supervision for screenshot relevance, not evidence that the full evaluator or all benchmark trajectories form a complete policy-training dataset.

最主要的新意，是把覆盖广泛且持续维护的真实网站任务，与视觉化、轨迹感知的结果 judge 结合。此前网页基准已分别提供网页任务、演示、在线交互或模型评分。Online-Mind2Web 将任务衰减和网站漂移提升为一等评测问题，而 WebJudge 则拆分关键点提取、证据画面筛选与终局判断。

对数据策展而言，最可复用的概念进展是明确区分动作轨迹、动作效果状态与 episode 成功。一次点击可以执行成功但任务最终失败；网站变化可使 episode 变为不可执行；决定性截图被过滤也会使 judge 失败。这种分解可推广到网页浏览之外的奖励与 verifier 数据集。

后续 v2 提交 schema 是有价值的发布工程，但不能倒推所有论文运行都按该 schema 完整捕获。同样，WebJudge-7B 证明截图相关性监督可用于奖励模型复用，却不能证明完整 evaluator 或全部基准轨迹已经构成完整的策略训练数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Mutable targets: Live pages, availability, content, CAPTCHA, region, session state, and task definitions change. Task replacements improve current validity but break longitudinal equivalence unless revisions are pinned.
  • Incomplete trajectory retention: Official artifacts include labels, evaluator outputs, examples, and a submission schema, but a complete raw corpus of all successful, failed, and not-executable paper episodes was not verified.
  • No exact replay: There are no immutable page snapshots or uniform account, cookie, locale, viewport, and remote-browser fixtures. Operator also runs in a distinct remote environment.
  • Judge failure modes: Screenshot selection can omit decisive evidence; visible state may not reveal server-side completion; alternate valid paths may be misread; judge choice changes precision and recall.
  • Split and contamination risk: The 300 tasks lack a canonical train/dev/test split or hidden holdout. Many derive from public Mind2Web data, and no model-overlap or cross-benchmark deduplication audit is reported.
  • Schema drift: The current v2 format detects missing step components, but v1 parallel arrays could silently desynchronize, and the later schema does not repair historical records.
  • Licensing, privacy, and safety gaps: Data is CC BY 4.0, code MIT, and WebJudge-7B Apache-2.0, but third-party page/screenshot rights are not itemized. Gating, a research-use disclaimer, and a no-PII instruction do not replace consent, redaction, credential, purchase, submission, or irreversible-action policies.
  • Heterogeneous execution: Agents use different browsers, viewports, capture modes, step budgets, and access products, so model quality is entangled with the interaction substrate.

• 目标持续变化： 实时页面、可用性、内容、CAPTCHA、地区、会话状态与任务定义都会变化。任务替换可改善当前有效性，但若不固定修订版本，就会破坏纵向可比性。
  • 轨迹保留不完整： 官方工件包含标签、评测器输出、示例和提交 schema，但尚未核实六类论文智能体全部成功、失败与不可执行 episode 的完整原始语料。
  • 无法精确回放： 没有不可变网页快照，也没有统一的账户、cookie、locale、视口与远程浏览器环境。Operator 还运行于不同的远程环境。
  • Judge 失效模式： 截图筛选可能漏掉决定性证据；可见状态未必反映服务器端完成；替代的有效路径可能被误读；judge 选择会改变精确率与召回率。
  • 切分与污染风险： 300 个任务没有 canonical train/dev/test 划分或隐藏留出集。许多任务源自公开 Mind2Web 数据，且论文未报告模型重叠或跨基准去重审计。
  • Schema 漂移： 当前 v2 格式可检测步骤组件缺失，但 v1 平行数组可能静默错位，后续 schema 也不能修复历史记录。
  • 许可、隐私与安全缺口： 数据采用 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT，WebJudge-7B 为 Apache-2.0，但第三方页面和截图权利未逐项说明。访问门控、研究用途声明与不记录 PII 的要求，不能替代同意、脱敏、凭据、购买、提交或不可逆动作政策。
  • 执行环境异构： 各智能体使用不同浏览器、视口、截图方式、步数预算与访问产品，因此模型质量与交互底座相互纠缠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Directly supported uses

  • Evaluate web agents on maintained live-site tasks with human or WebJudge episode outcomes.
  • Study action sequences, screenshot evidence selection, task executability, and judge disagreement when the corresponding submitted episode is retained.
  • Train or analyze screenshot-relevance reward/verifier components in the specific WebJudge-7B setting based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

Uses that require additional artifacts

  • Policy imitation or offline RL needs a licensed, complete corpus of successful and failed trajectories, including observations, factual actions, terminal labels, retries, and provenance. That corpus was not verified for all paper agents.
  • Reproducible longitudinal evaluation needs pinned task revisions, browser/environment manifests, account and locale fixtures, website captures, and fixed evaluator versions.
  • Benchmark training or leaderboard tuning needs a hidden or refreshed holdout and contamination controls; the public 300-task suite alone cannot provide those guarantees.

The metadata therefore keeps training_use at evaluation and reward modeling. Reward modeling refers specifically to the released WebJudge-7B screenshot-relevance component and its documented synthetic supervision, not to an inferred license or suitability for training a general browser policy.

有直接证据支持的用途

  • 在持续维护的实时网站任务上，以人类或 WebJudge 的 episode 结果评测网页智能体。
  • 在保留对应提交 episode 时，研究动作序列、截图证据筛选、任务可执行性与 judge 分歧。
  • 在以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为基础的特定 WebJudge-7B 设置中，训练或分析截图相关性奖励/verifier 组件。

需要额外工件才能支持的用途

  • 策略模仿或离线 RL 需要许可清晰、成功与失败均完整保留的轨迹语料，包括观察、事实动作、终局标签、重试与来源；目前未核实六类论文智能体均有此类语料。
  • 可复现的纵向评测需要固定任务修订、浏览器/环境清单、账户与 locale 环境、网站捕获及 evaluator 版本。
  • 基准训练或排行榜调优需要隐藏或持续刷新的留出集与污染控制；公开的 300 任务套件本身无法提供这些保证。

因此元数据把 training_use 保持为 evaluation 与 reward modeling。这里的 reward modeling 特指公开的 WebJudge-7B 截图相关性组件及其有文档依据的合成监督，并不推断其许可或数据适合训练通用浏览器策略。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the task-construction section first: it quantifies why static Mind2Web trajectories no longer represent current site behavior.
  • Keep task validity separate from agent failure; human labels include a distinct not-executable outcome.
  • In trajectory analysis, treat per-action SUCCESS as an execution observation, never as the terminal reward.
  • Inspect the WebJudge stages independently; evidence selection errors and outcome-judgment errors require different audits.
  • Pin the official paper, code, dataset, model, schema, task revision, and evaluator outputs before comparing runs.
  • Do not claim replayability or policy-training readiness unless complete trajectories, environment state, lineage, rights, and safety controls are supplied.

• 先读任务构建部分：它量化说明静态 Mind2Web 轨迹为何已不能代表当前网站行为。
  • 将任务有效性与智能体失败分开；人类标签含独立的“不可执行”结果。
  • 分析轨迹时，把单个动作的 SUCCESS 视为执行观察，绝不能当作终局奖励。
  • 分别检查 WebJudge 的各阶段；证据筛选错误与结果判断错误需要不同审计。
  • 比较运行结果前，应固定官方论文、代码、数据集、模型、schema、任务修订与 evaluator 输出。
  • 除非补齐完整轨迹、环境状态、来源链、权利与安全控制，否则不要声称可以回放或适合策略训练。

value.html: A mutable live-web benchmark plus submitted browser episodes and episode-level feedback. The task release contains 300 current task records across 136 sites. A v2 submitted episode binds task metadata to per-step screenshots, URLs, actions, optional thoughts, action-effect status, final answer, and later human or WebJudge outcome labels.

Starting from 650 randomly selected original Mind2Web tasks, the authors found 47% invalid or paired with outdated reference trajectories. The final 300 use 167 selected Mind2Web tasks, 24 rewritten Mind2Web tasks, 34 Mind2Web-Live tasks, and 75 newly authored tasks on popular or underrepresented websites.

The agent observes mutable live websites through screenshots. Open-source agents use Playwright; Claude Computer Use uses a local Chrome browser and Operator uses OpenAI's remote browser. Viewports differ: some agents capture extended full pages while others record only the visible region.

The current v2 schema standardizes navigation, click, type, scroll, hover, wait, key press, select, back, forward, refresh, and task-complete actions. The optional per-step SUCCESS/FAILED flag records whether an action visibly took effect, not whether the overall task was completed correctly.

Multi-step browser interaction ending with TASK_COMPLETE and an optional first-class agent final answer. WebJudge intentionally ignores final answers and intermediate model thoughts, relying on task text, factual action history, selected screenshots, and visible outcomes.

Evaluated agents generate live-browser episodes. The paper evaluates SeeAct, Agent-E, Browser Use, Claude Computer Use 3.5, Claude Computer Use 3.7, and Operator. Current submission schema also accepts third-party agent runs.

Public live websites started from benchmark-specified URLs, without a frozen page corpus or sandbox reset. Paper comparisons prohibit Google Search so agents stay on the intended site. Site content, structure, availability, bot defenses, regional state, accounts and remote-browser behavior can drift.

Human evaluators assign task-level failure, success, or not-executable labels. WebJudge first extracts required key points, scores/summarizes screenshots, retains frames at a relevance threshold, and then predicts binary episode success from task, key points, selected screenshots, and factual actions.

Binary episode success/failure for evaluation. Not-executable is a separate human label. WebJudge-7B learns key-screenshot relevance from synthetic supervision; its final key-point and outcome calls remain handled by an LLM.

Generation ends when the agent declares TASK_COMPLETE or reaches its agent-specific interaction limit. Benchmark success is assigned post hoc by humans or WebJudge; action-level SUCCESS and terminal emission alone do not establish task success.

Official artifacts include the gated 300-task JSON, code, prompts/evaluator, task-level human labels, WebJudge outputs, example trajectory packages, a v2 submission schema, and WebJudge-7B weights. The complete raw successful, failed and not-executable screenshot/action trajectories for all six paper agents were not verified as a public corpus.

Mind2Web/Mind2Web-Live or newly authored task -> viability, ambiguity and CAPTCHA filtering -> versioned public task -> specified start website -> live-browser screenshot/action episode -> human task label and/or WebJudge key-point, screenshot-selection and binary outcome records.

Agent evaluation uses SeeAct, Agent-E, Browser Use, Claude Computer Use 3.5, Claude Computer Use 3.7, and Operator. Open-agent backbones include gpt-4o-2024-08-06; Claude Computer Use 3.5 uses claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022. Operator is a remote product with no paper API.

At least two human annotators label every evaluated task trajectory and a third resolves disagreement. GPT-4o, GPT-4.1-mini, Claude 3.7, and Qwen2.5-VL-72B synthesize key-screenshot training targets for WebJudge-7B.

Human-derived task curation and evaluated-agent interaction. Task writers select, rewrite, or author tasks; agents generate browser trajectories; WebJudge models derive key points, screenshot relevance summaries/scores, and terminal judgments.
167 selected Mind2Web tasks, 24 rewritten Mind2Web tasks, 34 Mind2Web-Live tasks, and 75 newly authored tasks, covering 136 websites and 12 domains.

Final paper suite has 300 tasks: 83 easy with reference length at most 5, 143 medium with length 6-10, and 74 hard with length at least 11. Website selection prioritizes SimilarWeb traffic while adding 14 niche-site tasks and regional diversity.

The paper evaluates six agents over the benchmark and human-labels their trajectories, but retry/drop accounting and a complete run manifest are not disclosed. The current repository notes that leaderboard results average three runs; this later policy is not evidence of three paper runs.
WebJudge GPT-4o uses temperature 0; o4-mini uses default medium reasoning effort. Agent-wide decoding settings are not uniformly disclosed.

Open agents run online with Playwright, Claude Computer Use on local Chrome, and Operator in OpenAI's remote browser. Tasks begin at the specified website and Google Search is prohibited for the main comparison.

Remove ambiguous tasks, tasks invalidated by site or ground-truth changes, and tasks blocked by strong CAPTCHA. Rewritten tasks restore solvability or eliminate ambiguity. Later maintainers replace outdated/invalid tasks while aiming to preserve website and reference-length difficulty.
SeeAct, Browser Use, and Agent-E use at most 25 steps. Claude Computer Use 3.7 uses at most 50 steps with thinking disabled. Operator's remote-product budget is not disclosed.

WebJudge-7B fine-tunes Qwen2.5-VL-7B using screenshot-relevance targets from SeeAct, Browser Use, and Claude Computer Use 3.5 trajectories; Agent-E, Claude Computer Use 3.7, and Operator are held out. Training uses 4 H100 80GB GPUs, bfloat16, batch size 256, maximum length 4096, 5 epochs, learning rate 5e-6, cosine scheduling, and 10% warmup.
WebJudge retains screenshots whose relevance score is at least 3. Threshold 3 is fixed across agents; lower values increase token load and higher values can discard critical evidence.

167 selected Mind2Web tasks, 24 rewritten Mind2Web tasks, 34 Mind2Web-Live tasks, and 75 new tasks. The suite spans 136 websites and 12 domains; it intentionally mixes inherited crowdsourced tasks with author-written updates.

The 300 released tasks form a public evaluation set; no canonical task-level train/dev/test or hidden holdout is disclosed. WebJudge-7B instead splits by trajectory-producing agent: three agents for training and three held out.

Lineage to Mind2Web and Mind2Web-Live is explicit. The paper contrasts WebVoyager and samples 100 of its tasks for a search-shortcut audit, but no item-level semantic overlap manifest with WebVoyager or other live-web benchmarks is released.

No model-training overlap or cross-benchmark deduplication audit is disclosed. Many tasks descend from public Mind2Web/Mind2Web-Live and all current tasks are public or gated after acceptance, so post-release memorization and benchmark-specific tuning remain risks.

The repository releases task-level human labels 0/1/2 and WebJudge result directories across paper agents, preserving aggregate success, failure and not-executable outcomes. It provides example trajectory packages and a schema for submissions, but a complete public corpus of all paper screenshots, actions, thoughts, URLs, retries, successes and failures was not verified.

Exact replay is blocked by mutable external websites, regular task replacement, differing agent viewports, CAPTCHA/access changes, unspecified account/cookie/locale state, a remote Operator browser, missing complete run packages, and absent immutable page snapshots. Versioned tasks improve comparison but do not freeze observations or outcomes.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: WebJudge can miss decisive frames if screenshot relevance scoring filters them out; threshold 2, 3 and 4 yield different agreement.
Binary visible-outcome judgment can misread hidden server state, stale page state, alternate valid paths, or task completion that lacks a decisive frame.
Action histories must contain factual actions only; including hallucinated agent final responses raises false positives.
o4-mini is more conservative on out-of-domain benchmarks and can have high precision but low recall; judge choice changes labels and success rates.
GPT-4o remains stochastic at temperature 0; three runs have average success-rate standard deviation 1.1% and maximum 1.8%.
v1 parallel action, thought and screenshot arrays could silently desynchronize; the later v2 schema detects rather than retrospectively repairs old gaps.
Website drift, CAPTCHAs, unavailable pages and regional/session differences can change executability independently of agent capability.

value.html: The gated dataset requests contact sharing and states research-only, non-harmful use. The v2 schema forbids passwords or PII in typed-action text. The paper/repository does not provide a complete account-fixture policy, privacy/redaction log, subject-consent record, or IRB statement for captured third-party web content and submitted screenshots.

The dataset card and repository state CC BY 4.0 for Online-Mind2Web data; repository code is MIT; the WebJudge-7B model card is Apache-2.0. These declarations do not enumerate rights for third-party website screenshots, page content, trademarks, or submitted agent trajectories.

Aggregate source counts and current task IDs are available. Record-level original IDs, rewrite diffs, annotator identities, validity decisions, task replacement history, run IDs, browser state, retries, and links from every judgment to a complete immutable trajectory are incomplete.

Paper, COLM record, task dataset, code, evaluator prompts, human/WebJudge task labels, example trajectories, v2 submission schema, and WebJudge-7B weights are public or access-gated. No GitHub Release/tag or immutable end-to-end environment/result bundle exists.
